title: Sample week 33 — fixture for the reader app
tldr: This bundled issue exists so the Expo app can render before a cloud agent writes a real brief. Treat every item below as UI fixture copy, not reporting.

items.headline: Sample: a developer-facing Apple change this week
items.summary: Fixture. In a real issue this would be a 2–4 sentence account of an iOS, macOS, App Store, or privacy change, with dates and names taken from primary sources.
items.whyItMatters: You live on Apple hardware; this slot is for anything that changes your phone, Mac, or shipping an app.

items.headline: Sample: Cursor product or cloud-agent news
items.summary: Fixture. Real issues should cite Cursor docs, changelog, or the forum — models, automations, pricing, or agent workflow — not training-cutoff guesses.
items.whyItMatters: This is your editor. Cover what would change how you run agents or ship code this week.

items.headline: Sample: a model, lab, or regulation item worth knowing
items.summary: Fixture. Prefer lab blogs, official model cards, or primary regulation text over aggregator recaps.
items.whyItMatters: You build with AI tools; this slot is for changes that affect quality, cost, or what you are allowed to use.

items.headline: Sample: a platform, security, or infrastructure story
items.summary: Fixture. Use this beat for notable tech that is not primarily Apple, Cursor, or AI — outages, security incidents, or platform policy.
items.whyItMatters: Only include it if it would change how you work, ship, or stay safe this week.

items.headline: Minta: egy hét itthon, ami számít
items.summary: Ez egy UI-minta, nem tudósítás. Éles számban magyar forrásból, természetes magyarsággal kellene leírni, mi történt politikában, gazdaságban, EU-ügyben vagy a mindennapi infrastruktúrában.
items.whyItMatters: Azért van ez a rovat, hogy ne essen ki a magyar valóság a tech-hírek mögül.

items.headline: Sample: a world story with a real impact
items.summary: Fixture. Skip generic wire copy. Keep items that affect travel, money, safety, or civic life for someone in Hungary.
items.whyItMatters: The point of this section is staying in touch with the world without a second news app.
